question: Should OpenClaw accept `state:persist` as a permanent Workspaces custom-widget API, with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101329 landing before this notes consumer?
rationale: This creates a durable plugin API and stored-data contract beyond the notes UI; code review cannot choose that permanent product boundary or stacked landing order.

options.title: Land persistence first
options.body: Approve and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101329, then rebase this PR to contain only the built-in notes consumer and its focused proof.

options.title: Review the combined stack
options.body: Keep the cumulative branch and explicitly approve the persistence API, schema, security boundary, and notes UI as one larger landing unit.

options.title: Decline the persistence API
options.body: Pause or redesign the notes feature if custom-widget persistent state is not an intended permanent Workspaces capability.

recommendation.title: Land persistence first
recommendation.body: Approve and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101329, then rebase this PR to contain only the built-in notes consumer and its focused proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available repository-owner signal directly subscribed to this feature series.
